ucs.title: [LLM] LockBit 3.0 (Black) encryptor execution via -pass/-k authentication argument
ucs.description: LockBit 3.0 (a.k.a. LockBit Black, evolved into LockBit Green/5.0) encryptor binaries require a 32-byte hexadecimal password supplied as `-pass <hex>` (or `-k`/`-id`) to decrypt the embedded routine, and accept LockBit-unique affiliate switches (-gdel, -gspd, -psex, -wall, -safe, -nomutex, -localonly). This argument signature does not appear in legitimate software and was documented in CISA AA23-165A and Trend Micro / Sophos LockBit Black analyses.
ucs.splunk:
| tstats summariesonly=true count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime values(Processes.process) as process values(Processes.process_path) as image values(Processes.parent_process_name) as parent values(Processes.process_hash) as sha256 from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where Processes.process IN ("* -pass *","* -k *","* -gdel*","* -gspd*","* -psex*","* -wall*","* -safe*","* -nomutex*","* -localonly*") by host Processes.user Processes.process_name
| `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)`
| eval has_pass_hex=if(match(process, "(?i)\s-(pass|k|id)\s+[A-Fa-f0-9]{32,}"),1,0)
| eval has_lb_flag=if(match(process, "(?i)\s-(gdel|gspd|psex|wall|safe|nomutex|localonly)\b"),1,0)
| where (has_pass_hex=1 OR has_lb_flag=1) AND NOT match(user, "\$$")
| `security_content_ctime(firstTime)` | `security_content_ctime(lastTime)`
| sort - lastTime
ucs.kql:
let LookbackDays = 14d;
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
| where AccountName !endswith "$"
| where AccountName !in~ ("system","local service","network service")
| extend HasPassHex = ProcessCommandLine matches regex @"(?i)\s-(pass|k|id)\s+[A-Fa-f0-9]{32,}"
| extend HasLBFlag  = ProcessCommandLine matches regex @"(?i)\s-(gdel|gspd|psex|wall|safe|nomutex|localonly)\b"
| where HasPassHex or HasLBFlag
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName, FileName, FolderPath,
          ProcessCommandLine, InitiatingProcessFileName,
          InitiatingProcessCommandLine, InitiatingProcessAccountName,
          SHA256, MD5, HasPassHex, HasLBFlag
| order by Timestamp desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
let LookbackDays = 14d;
SecurityEvent
| where TimeGenerated > ago(LookbackDays)
| where EventID == 4688
| where AccountName !endswith "$"
| extend HasPassHex = CommandLine matches regex @"(?i)\s-(pass|k|id)\s+[A-Fa-f0-9]{32,}"
| extend HasLBFlag  = CommandLine matches regex @"(?i)\s-(gdel|gspd|psex|wall|safe|nomutex|localonly)\b"
| where HasPassHex or HasLBFlag
| project TimeGenerated, Computer, AccountName, NewProcessName, CommandLine,

ucs.sigma_yaml:
title: LockBit 3.0 Black Encryptor - pass/k Authentication Argument
id: 4b6c7a8e-9d12-4d3e-bcf1-7a3a9e8e1f23
status: experimental
description: Detects LockBit 3.0/Black/Green encryptor execution which requires a 32-byte hex password supplied via -pass/-k/-id command-line arguments and LockBit-unique propagation switches.
references:
  - https://www.cisa.gov/news-events/cybersecurity-advisories/aa23-165a
author: SOC Detection Engineering
date: 2026/06/19
tags:
  - attack.impact
  - attack.t1486
  - attack.t1490
  - attack.t1562.001
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection_pass_hex:
    CommandLine|re: '(?i)\s-(pass|k|id)\s+[A-Fa-f0-9]{32,}'
  selection_lockbit_args:
    CommandLine|contains:
      - ' -gdel'
      - ' -gspd'
      - ' -psex'
      - ' -wall'
      - ' -safe'
      - ' -nomutex'
      - ' -localonly'
  filter_machine:
    User|endswith: '$'
  condition: (selection_pass_hex or selection_lockbit_args) and not filter_machine
falsepositives:
  - Internal red-team emulation of LockBit Black
level: high
ucs.datadog_query: source:(windows.sysmon OR windows.security) (@EventID:1 OR @EventID:4688) (@CommandLine:(*\ \-pass\ * OR *\ \-k\ * OR *\ \-gdel* OR *\ \-gspd* OR *\ \-psex* OR *\ \-wall* OR *\ \-safe* OR *\ \-nomutex* OR *\ \-localonly*)) -@User:*$ -@SubjectUserName:*$
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2
| CommandLine=/(?i)\s-(pass|k|id)\s+[A-Fa-f0-9]{32,}/ OR CommandLine=/(?i)\s-(gdel|gspd|psex|wall|safe|nomutex|localonly)\b/
| NOT UserName=/\$$/i
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, UserName, ImageFileName, CommandLine, SHA256HashData, ParentBaseFileName], function=[count(), min(@timestamp, as=firstSeen), max(@timestamp, as=lastSeen)])
| sort(lastSeen, order=desc)
ucs.rationale: The `-pass <32-byte-hex>` argument is hard-coded into the LockBit 3.0 builder (leaked Sept 2022 and the basis for every Black/Green/5.0 sample since). Combined with affiliate switches -gdel (group-policy shadow-copy purge), -gspd (group-policy spread), -psex (PsExec spread), and -wall (drop wallpaper note), this command-line shape is essentially a LockBit fingerprint. No legitimate Windows softwar

ucs.title: [LLM] LockBit pre-encryption host-sabotage chain (shadow purge + recovery disable + service kill within 5 min)
ucs.description: LockBit affiliates (2.0/3.0/Black/Green/5.0 - tracked by CrowdStrike as BITWISE SPIDER and by Microsoft as part of the broader RaaS ecosystem) execute a tightly choreographed pre-encryption sequence on each victim host: vssadmin/wmic shadow-copy deletion, bcdedit recoveryenabled No + ignoreallfailures, wbadmin catalog purge, wevtutil log clear, and bulk net-stop/taskkill of database, mail, and backup services. The encryptor itself spawns this chain back-to-back; observing 3+ distinct sabotage stages from one host within 5 minutes is a high-fidelity LockBit kill-chain anchor.
ucs.splunk:
| tstats summariesonly=true count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime values(Processes.process) as cmds values(Processes.parent_process_name) as parents values(Processes.process_name) as procs from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where (Processes.process="*vssadmin*delete*shadows*" OR Processes.process="*vssadmin*resize*shadowstorage*" OR Processes.process="*wmic*shadowcopy*delete*" OR Processes.process="*bcdedit*recoveryenabled*no*" OR Processes.process="*bcdedit*bootstatuspolicy*ignoreallfailures*" OR Processes.process="*wbadmin*delete*catalog*" OR Processes.process="*wbadmin*delete*systemstatebackup*" OR Processes.process="*wevtutil*cl*" OR Processes.process="*net*stop*MSSQL*" OR Processes.process="*net*stop*Veeam*" OR Processes.process="*net*stop*BackupExec*" OR Processes.process="*net*stop*MSExchange*" OR Processes.process="*taskkill*sqlservr*" OR Processes.process="*taskkill*sqlwriter*" OR Processes.process="*taskkill*mysqld*") by _time span=5m host Processes.user
| `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)`
| eval stage=case(match(cmds,"(?i)vssadmin.*(delete|resize).*shadow|wmic.*shadowcopy.*delete"),"shadow_delete",match(cmds,"(?i)bcdedit.*(recoveryenabled\s+no|bootstatuspolicy\s+ignoreallfailures)"),"boot_recovery_off",match(cmds,"(?i)wbadmin.*(delete\s+catalog|delete\s+systemstatebackup)"),"backup_purge",match(cmds,"(?i)wevtutil\s+cl"),"event_log_clear",match(cmds,"(?i)(net\s+stop|taskkill).*(MSSQL|sqlservr|sqlwriter|mysqld|Veeam|BackupExec|MSExchange|memtas|mepocs)"),"service_stop",true(),"other")
| where stage!="other"
| stats values(stage) as stages dc(stage) as stage_count values(cmds) as sample_cmds min(firstTime) as firstTime max(lastTime) as lastTime by host user
| where stage_count>=3
| `security_content_ctime(firstTime)` | `security_content_ctime(lastTime)`
| sort - lastTime
ucs.kql:
let LookbackHours = 24h;
let Window = 5m;
let Sabotage =
    DeviceProcessEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackHours)
    | where AccountName !endswith "$"
    | extend Cmd = tolower(ProcessCommandLine)
    | extend Stage = case(
        Cmd matches regex @"vssadmin\s+(delete|resize)\s+shadow" or Cmd has_all ("wmic","shadowcopy","delete"), "shadow_delete",
        Cmd matches regex @"bcdedit.*recoveryenabled\s+no" or Cmd matches regex @"bcdedit.*bootstatuspolicy\s+ignoreallfailures", "boot_recovery_off",
        Cmd matches regex @"wbadmin\s+delete\s+(catalog|systemstatebackup)", "backup_purge",
        Cmd matches regex @"wevtutil\s+cl\s", "event_log_clear",
        (Cmd has_all ("net","stop") or Cmd has "taskkill") and Cmd has_any ("mssql","sqlservr","sqlwriter","mysqld","veeam","backupexec","msexchange","memtas","mepocs"), "service_stop",
        "other")
    | where Stage != "other"
    | project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName, FileName, ProcessCommandLine, Stage,
              InitiatingProcessFileName, InitiatingProcessCommandLine, InitiatingProcessSHA256;
Sabotage
| summarize Stages = make_set(Stage), StageCount = dcount(Stage),
            FirstSeen = min(Timestamp), LastSeen = max(Timestamp),
            SampleCmds = make_list(ProcessCommandLine, 15),
            Initiators = make_set(InitiatingProcessFileName, 10),
            EncryptorHashes = make_set(InitiatingProcessSHA256, 10)
            by DeviceName, AccountName, bin(Timestamp, Window)
| where StageCount >= 3
| order by FirstSeen desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
let LookbackHours = 24h;
let Window = 5m;
let Sabotage =
    SecurityEvent
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(LookbackHours)
    | where EventID == 4688
    | where AccountName !endswith "$"
    | extend Cmd = tolower(CommandLine)
    | extend Stage = case(
        Cmd matches regex @"vssadmin\s+(delete|resize)\s+shadow" or Cmd has_all ("wmic","shadowcopy","delete"), "shadow_delete",
        Cmd matches regex @"bcdedit.*recoveryenabled\s+no" or Cmd matches regex @"bcdedit.*bootstatuspolicy\s+ignoreallfailures", "boot_recovery_off",
        Cmd matches regex @"wbadmin\s+delete\s+(catalog|systemstatebackup)", "backup_purge",
        Cmd matches regex @"wevtutil\s+cl\s", "event_log_clear",
        (Cmd has_all ("net","stop") or Cmd has "taskkill") and Cmd has_any ("mssql","sqlservr","sqlwriter","mysqld","veeam","backupexec","msexchange","memtas","mepocs"), "service_stop",
        "other")
    | where Stage != "other"
    | project TimeGenerated, Computer, AccountName, NewProcessName, CommandLine, Stage, ParentProcessName;
Sabotage
| summarize Stages = make_set(Stage), StageCount = dcount(Stage),
            FirstSeen = min(TimeGenerated), LastSeen = max(TimeGenerated),
            SampleCmds = make_list(CommandLine, 15),
            Parents = make_set(ParentProcessName, 10)
            by Computer, AccountName, bin(TimeGenerated, Window)
| where StageCount >= 3
| order by FirstSeen desc
ucs.datadog_query: source:(windows.sysmon OR windows.security) (@EventID:1 OR @EventID:4688) @CommandLine:(*vssadmin*delete*shadow* OR *vssadmin*resize*shadowstorage* OR *wmic*shadowcopy*delete* OR *bcdedit*recoveryenabled*No* OR *bcdedit*recoveryenabled*no* OR *bcdedit*bootstatuspolicy*ignoreallfailures* OR *wbadmin*delete*catalog* OR *wbadmin*delete*systemstatebackup* OR *wevtutil*cl* OR *net*stop*MSSQL* OR *net*stop*Veeam* OR *net*stop*BackupExec* OR *net*stop*MSExchange* OR *taskkill*sqlservr* OR *taskkill*sqlwriter* OR *taskkill*mysqld*) -@User:*$ -@SubjectUserName:*$
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2
| CommandLine=/(?i)(vssadmin\s+(delete|resize)\s+shadow|wmic\s+shadowcopy\s+delete|bcdedit.*recoveryenabled\s+no|bcdedit.*bootstatuspolicy\s+ignoreallfailures|wbadmin\s+delete\s+(catalog|systemstatebackup)|wevtutil\s+cl|net\s+stop.*(MSSQL|Veeam|BackupExec|MSExchange|memtas|mepocs)|taskkill.*(sqlservr|sqlwriter|mysqld|MSExchange))/
| NOT UserName=/\$$/
| Stage := if(CommandLine=/(?i)vssadmin|shadowcopy/, then="shadow_delete", else=if(CommandLine=/(?i)bcdedit/, then="boot_recovery_off", else=if(CommandLine=/(?i)wbadmin/, then="backup_purge", else=if(CommandLine=/(?i)wevtutil/, then="event_log_clear", else="service_stop"))))
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, UserName, bucket(span=5m, field=@timestamp)], function=[count(field=Stage, distinct=true, as=stage_count), collect([Stage, CommandLine, ParentBaseFileName])])
| stage_count >= 3
| sort(_bucket, order=desc)
